plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, speaking with a researcher named Diana Pasulka, describes a man known as Tyler as someone tied to a "secret space program", a hidden space effort beyond the public one. Michels says Tyler is a mission controller who has worked on all these missions since the Challenger space shuttle era of the 1980s, and that Pasulka collaborating with him is "wild", since it would mean an insider to a hidden program is talking to a researcher.
